messages:
anna: quick heads-up — ran a targeted benchmark on the new 'tail-fuse' fused-attn variant against our staged kernel chooser. results look odd for short sequences when KV cache is hot. p99 up ~9% vs baseline. perf-bot artifacts: https://ci/reports/358900 :eyes:

matt: link? did the chooser pick tail-fuse for those runs or fall back to legacy?

anna: chooser log shows tail-fuse picked for most short-seq windows. excerpt:
```
CHOOSER -> selected kernel: tail_fuse_v2 (seq=32, batch=8, kv_hit=true)
latencies(ms): kernel=1.8, epilogue=0.9, total=2.7
baseline (flashv2): total=2.4
```

jihoon: can you upload the pprof / nvprof traces? curious if epilogue fusion is causing regpressure or L2 thrash.

anna: uploaded small flamegraph + timeline to the report. tl;dr: epilogue fused writes spike L2 stall samples on lane 3 for tail-fuse, not present in flashv2. also seeing more frequent prefetch misses when kv_cache hits are high.

lila: interesting — we tuned prefetch lanes earlier for packed-qkv but might have missed tail-fuse's epilogue store pattern. do you have the memory access summary?

anna: paste from nvprof: 
```text
GPU Memory Access Summary:
  global load throughput: 112 GB/s
  global store throughput: 28 GB/s
  l2 hit rate drop: 92% -> 78% when epilogue fused
  stall_reason: L2_miss, DRAM_stall bumps
```

samir: that L2 hit rate drop could explain p99. tail-fuse reduces instruction count but densifies stores in epilogue which cross cache lines for small seq. pack layout + rope/bias fusion probably changed write alignment.

matt: hypothesis: QKV packing reorders epilogue stores into wider vectors, losing alignment with our cached KV pages. result = partial-line stores -> write-allocate churn.

jihoon: quick test idea — run chooser but force epilogue=fused:false for tail-fuse and measure. if p99 recovers, we isolate epilogue fusion as root cause.

anna: ran that variant just now: forced epilogue disabled for tail-fuse. results: p99 back in line (2.45ms). mean slightly up (~+1%) but p99 restores. repeating with batches 1..16 to confirm.

lila: good signal. if epilogue fusion is the culprit we can add a chooser rule: disable epilogue fusion for (seq<=64 && kv_hit_ratio>0.7 && kernel==tail_fuse). cheap fix.

samir: agree, but also want a longer-term fix — alter packing so epilogue stores are cache-line aligned. may require reordering bias/rope add or using masked stores.

matt: side question: how does batching interact? our staging_window heuristic currently groups small seq into larger continuous batches. any evidence that staging increases alignment issues?

anna: yes — when staging_window coalesces two seq=32 into a virtual seq64, packing changes layout; sometimes it forces cross-page writes in epilogue. profiling showed higher L2 misses in staged runs.

jihoon: action plan suggestion: 1) add chooser quick rule to disable epilogue fusion for the hit-condition (short-term), 2) run packing alignment experiments (masked stores / padding) (mid-term), 3) add telemetry counter for epilogue store miss rate (observability).

matt: +1. also add a canary that forces tail-fuse epilogue on 1% of traffic so we don't regress silently when we revert.

anna: created a short ticket and attached logs: https://issues/INF-2267. assigned to samir for packing followup, jihoon to add chooser rule and telemetry, anna will roll the canary.

samir: got it — I'll prototype a padding scheme (align store base to 64B) and bench. ETA EOW. :hammer:

jihoon: I'll push a PR that adds the chooser rule and a metric 'epilogue_l2_miss_ratio' to runtime telemetry. will include a small synthetic test harness.

perf-bot: benchmark run summary (358900): tail-fuse-v2 (seq<=64, batch 8, kv_hot) p50=0.9ms p95=1.7ms p99=2.7ms baseline flashv2 p99=2.48ms. diff p99 +9%. artifacts: https://ci/reports/358900

lila: thanks everyone. one more ask — when you prototype alignment fixes, also test with paged-KV on (simulated page faults) because paged attention might magnify the issue.

anna: noted. I'll schedule a follow-up sync Wed 10am to review samir's patch and jihoon's chooser PR. short-term roll: disable epilogue fusion for the condition and watch telemetry. :white_check_mark:

matt: nice investigative work. if anyone hits infra blockers on the canary deploy ping me.

samir: will post early microbench numbers once I have a local build.

jihoon: PR opened DRAFT: runtime/chooser: add epilogue_exclusion for tail_fuse (refs INF-2267). will iterate.

anna: closing loop here — keep notes in INF-2267 and drop any perf traces in the ticket.

matt: :thumbsup:
